> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **15** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a8acee28dd57b203789349f51a222e6d69f43b40` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `b940fa9c220b1374fc23319ea783a61cc266b569` — the merge of head `afa654081f46e1b144020b31fbac22a4238d74a9` into base `a8acee28dd57b203789349f51a222e6d69f43b40`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin b940fa9c220b1374fc23319ea783a61cc266b569 && git checkout b940fa9c220b1374fc23319ea783a61cc266b569
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin a8acee28dd57b203789349f51a222e6d69f43b40 afa654081f46e1b144020b31fbac22a4238d74a9 && git checkout -B drift-repro a8acee28dd57b203789349f51a222e6d69f43b40 && git merge --no-ff afa654081f46e1b144020b31fbac22a4238d74a9

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a8acee28dd57b203789349f51a222e6d69f43b40
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs a8acee28dd57b203789349f51a222e6d69f43b40` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `afa654081f46e1b144020b31fbac22a4238d74a9`
Local-runs: none

Reviewed PR #20703 (stage 6 of #20594, `packages/client/src`) against the card body, all 23 card comments (the binding direction is the card body plus ruling C+D, `5749154545` on #19123, as PR #20533 and stages 1 to 5 apply it), the PR body, the file list (one page of 8, pages 2 and 3 empty), the net diff against `main` (415 lines, 8 files), and the check-runs on the head. Anchor and number reads went through `gh api` (REST). Nothing was built, run or re-run; the 53 head files of `packages/client/src` were fetched by the contents API and scanned as text.

### ① Derived judgments

**Accept-set and public-surface changes the diff implies: none.** Every one of the 88 changed lines in the 7 source files is a comment line (44 removed, 44 added; each payload begins `//`, `*` or `/**`). No code token, string literal, error message, identifier or test assertion moves. Checked: the whole of `src/index.ts`'s diff (19 pairs: 13 docblock `*` lines, 6 `//` lines, including the in-body comments at :1834 and :1838 beside `metaSaveHeaders`/`fetch` and the trailing re-export comment at :8122 inside `export type {}`), and every hunk of the six test files. The test titles that carry dead numbers (`it('[#12195] ...')`, `describe('[#12181] ...')`) are context lines, untouched. The 8th file is the new changeset. Judged right.

**(1) Comment-only: yes.** Named tokens that moved: none. The only line beyond the 43 sites is `client.test.ts:2198`, the second half of the `:2197` sentence ("byte-identical to the behavior before / commit cf74a1128."), a comment line.

**(2) Anchors.** 12 distinct shas stand on added lines (`cf74a1128` x8, `cf71d73f8` x6, `7986d973f` x6, `311433f6b` x5, `e944fdb24` x4, `90bbf2510` x3, `b1b978c8d` x2, `79c46da90` x2, `f549a0d4a`, `caaae2cca`, `74049254d`, `7092d63e4`); 0 shas on removed lines. Each was read with `gh api repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/commits/SHA` (exists, one parent each) and `compare/SHA...main` (all 12 answer `status=ahead`, `behind_by=0`). Each commit's message, changeset and patch were read, not only its subject. Sites checked line by line, 25 across all 7 files (the remaining 19 lines repeat the same number-to-anchor pairs inside `index.ts`):
- `index.ts:684`, `:728`, `:1834`, `:2021`; `client.test.ts:2869`; `meta-automation-descriptors.test.ts:29` (#12195 to `7986d973f`): the commit's own patch adds these very lines and the `encodeURIComponent` spelling on every `/meta` address; subject "Retire compound-name metadata addressing, un-mount the three `:section` arities and unify SDK URL spelling (#12176 stage 3)". Right.
- `client.test.ts:357`; `meta-automation-descriptors.test.ts:31` (#12176 to `7986d973f`): the lines say the retirement of compound-name addressing; `7986d973f` is the stage that completes it and wrote both lines. Right.
- `index.ts:738`, `:1838`, `:2026`; `client.test.ts:360`; `meta-automation-descriptors.test.ts:43` (#12194 to `311433f6b`): subject "Declare the metadata item-name grammar in spec and refuse it loudly at the publish door (#12176 stage 1)"; changeset declares `METADATA_ITEM_NAME_PATTERN` (snake case, optionally dot-qualified) and the 400 refusal at `saveMetaItem`/`publishMetaItem`. Right, and "Stage 1" is kept beside the sha at `:738`.
- `index.ts:799`, `:820`, `:911`, `:1866`; `meta-delete-item-carriers.test.ts:4`, `:265` (#12181 to `cf71d73f8`): subject "meta.deleteItem sends the reset door's If-Match pin and ?state=draft, on both declarations"; its patch adds all six lines, and its changeset states the `?dropStorage` withholding in the terms `:820` and `:265` now carry ("no caller was measured needing it from this client ... a separate, separately reviewable widening"). The test's "2026-08-28 ruling" matches the file's own header (written by that commit) and the commit date 2026-08-29. Right.
- `index.ts:3479`, `:3635`, `:7536`; `client.data-prefix.test.ts:4`; `client.test.ts:2165`, `:2197` (#14879 to `cf74a1128`): subject "fix(client): read the CRUD data prefix from discovery instead of restating /data"; patch adds `_dataPrefix()`, the data-prefix test file and the case-B re-pin ("WAS pinned the other way", "pre-#14879"). Right. `index.ts:3552` and `client.metadata-prefix.test.ts:7` were written by the metadata-prefix sibling and cite `cf74a1128` as the defect it fixed one key over. Right.
- `index.ts:4911`; `return-type-precision.test.ts:1031`, `:1130` (#14313 to `b1b978c8d`): subject "bind the auth.* family to the wire shapes better-auth sends"; message and patch state `auth.deleteUser` is deliberately NOT bound and pin it as an equality to `any`. Right.
- `return-type-precision.test.ts:891`, `:973`, `:981` (#14312 to `e944fdb24`): subject "bind the oauth.* family"; changeset "Card 1 of 3 of the #12104 family"; message states `oauth.applications.delete` is deliberately NOT bound because "binding it needs a behaviour change", which is the open decision `:973` and `:981` name. Right.
- `return-type-precision.test.ts:1138` (#14314 to `7092d63e4`): subject "bind the organizations.* family", changeset "Card 3 of 3 of the #12104 family". Right.
- `index.ts:6379`; `client.test.ts:878`, `:1390` (#6361 to `90bbf2510`): subject "retire the notification-list `cursor` on both halves"; patch removes `cursor` from `notifications.list` and `params.set('cursor', ...)`, registered in `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[17]`, so "removed in protocol 17" holds. Right.
- `index.ts:7406`; `client.test.ts:27` (#9934 to `79c46da90`): subject "producer-side user-facing marking for hook refusal messages, userMessage channel (#9934)"; patch adds `error.userMessage` read from both dialects. Right.
- `index.ts:8122` (#6239 to `f549a0d4a`): the ADR-0049 retirement sweep whose `view-management-protocol-retired` changeset removes `ViewProtocol`'s five methods and ten schemas and says "`@objectstack/client` drops the five response types it re-exported"; its patch wrote this line. Right.
- `client.test.ts:512` (#8480 to `caaae2cca`): subject "typed security.explain() request gains the recordIds batch spelling", changeset names #8480 and #8326 (kept, 200). Right.
- `return-type-precision.test.ts:1394`, `:1415` (#13208 to `74049254d`): subject "DeleteMetaItemResponseSchema declares seq and projectionApplied (#13208)", changeset for #13155, patch adds `seq` and `projectionApplied` as `.optional()`. #13208 is the PR that landed as this commit and answers 404; #13155 is kept. Right.

No wrong or unsupported anchor. Two wording wobbles, not defects: `client.test.ts:878` "The retired half of commit 90bbf2510 asserted where it was PRODUCED" (a commit has no retired half; the sense, the producer half that commit retired, is recoverable) and `return-type-precision.test.ts:973` "commit e944fdb24's open decision" (the decision that commit left open). Both anchors are the deciding commits.

**(3) Numbers.** The 13 dropped numbers (#12195, #12176, #12194, #12181, #14879, #14313, #14312, #14314, #6361, #9934, #6239, #8480, #13208) each answer 404 by REST at this read. The three numbers on changed lines that answer 200 (#8326, #12104 x3, #13155) are kept on their added lines; per-hunk set difference added-minus-removed is empty in every hunk, so no number is added, and the numbers in context lines (#16675, #15451, #11095, #3821, #11713, #13023, #7735, #4451, #11712, #3563, #11391, #3587) answer 200 and are untouched. Right.

**(4) Line counts.** From the file list, additions equal deletions for every source file (1/1, 1/1, 10/10, 19/19, 3/3, 2/2, 8/8; the changeset is +10/-0). From the fetched files, base and head line counts are equal per file (332, 367, 3178, 8187, 112, 633, 1480). Right.

**(6) `Part of #20594` and none left.** The PR body's first line is `Part of #20594`, the second `Clause-②: no`, no closing keyword; the card stays open for `mcp`, `qa`, `cloud-connection`, `plugin-hono-server` and the rest of the lane, the form-D string stage and the files outside `src/**`. `Part-of PR must not also close its card` and `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` are green. Right. On the head, every `.ts` file under `packages/client/src` (53) was scanned for tracker numbers in comment prose (full-line and trailing comments; string literals not read): 768 comment sites citing 169 distinct numbers, and all 169 answer 200, so 0 dead comment sites remain in the package. The dev's own figure for this stage is 19 to 0 (the brief's "52 to 0" is stage 4's figure for `packages/types`). The 18 dead numbers in test titles are string literals, the form-D stage, correctly left. At my read 9 PRs are open; only #20639 (Version Packages) touches `packages/client`, outside `src/**`. Nothing is left behind by this stage.

**Check-runs on the head at 2026-09-29T19:18:56Z** (newest run per name, 32 names, no re-runs): 27 `success`, 3 `skipped` (Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Packed-tarball smoke, path-filtered), 2 `in_progress` (Test Core (4/6), Type Check · workspace), 0 failed. Among the completed: Check Changeset, Lint & Repo Gates, Build Core, Test Core 1/2/3/5/6, Type Check · source/consumer/debt ledger, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate 1-3 and Dogfood Verify CLI, Temporal Conformance, both single-claim guards. No verdict is inferred for the two still running.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/client-provenance-anchors.md`: `'@objectstack/client': patch`, non-empty body in PR #20632's form ("Provenance comments in `@objectstack/client` were re-anchored ... Comments only: no request, route, error code, type, export or runtime behaviour changes."). `Check Changeset` is green.

**(5) Judged right.** The dispatch (`5896199946`) ordered a changeset only if the rewritten comments reach `dist`, as stage 5 (PR #20689, `skip-changeset`, six dist files byte-identical) measured. The dev measured that here they do: `index.d.ts`, `index.d.mts`, `index.js` and `index.mjs` differ at base and head with identical parser tokens, and "commit cf74a1128" appears in `index.d.ts`. That measurement is consistent with the structure of the diff: `@objectstack/client` publishes `dist` (`files[]` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`; `build` is tsup with `check-dts-emitted`), and the rewritten docblocks sit on exported type members (`SaveMetaItemOptions` at :684/:728/:738, `DeleteMetaItemOptions` at :799/:820) and on public class members (`meta.getPublished` :2021, `_dataPrefix` :3479, `_metadataPrefix` :3552, `_apiBase` :3635, `auth.deleteUser` :4911, `notifications.list` :6379, `ScopedEnvironmentClient.dataUrl` :7536), which the declaration emitter carries into `.d.ts`, the hover text a consumer reads. Stage 5's file was a runtime internal whose comments reached no emitted file; this one is the package entry. So the diff publishes prose and takes a changeset; `patch` is the right level (no behaviour, no accept set, no export moves), and `skip-changeset` would have been wrong here under AGENTS.md's Post-Task step 3. No `Clause-②: yes` is owed: no accept set widens or narrows.

Clause-②: no, judged right.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: none in the dev report (`5896800163`). Dev flags (deviations and out-of-scope findings), each answered:
- One companion line `client.test.ts:2198`: the other half of the `:2197` sentence, comment line, line count kept. Accepted.
- H0 measured at base `3b47a693c7` rather than the dispatch's `0be898499f`: no `packages/client/src` change between them (the 7 base blobs equal the copies at `f11b5f20a2` too), counts equal the seat's. Accepted.
- H2 holds on the parser-token reading and not byte-for-byte on `dist`: that is the changeset's reason, judged in ②. Accepted.
- First label-write call without the fleet token (exit 3, nothing written) and first `check-closing-target-claim` run without `PR_HEAD_REF` (exit 2): reruns exit 0; CI's own claim guards are green. Process notes, no effect on the diff.
- First dist-token code control landed inside the `sourceMappingURL` comment and was void, redone after a newline: the redone control reads COUNT DIFFERS, so the guard is armed. Accepted.
- `origin/main` moved to `a8acee28dd` after the one merge, no second merge: `mergeable=true`; CI judges the merge ref, and the two later commits touch `packages/spec` and a generated page only. Accepted.
- Model-free trailer pair per AGENTS.md rather than the harness reminder: a project instruction, not a contract matter.
- Out of scope, 18 dead numbers in test-title strings (#12195 6, #12181 5, #14879 4, #9934, #8480, #6361): the card's form-D stage (ACCEPT `5888034755` keeps it on #20594). Right to leave; no string moved.
- Out of scope, `packages/client/tsconfig.json:8` and `vitest.config.ts:33` (#12181, anchor `cf71d73f8`) and `test-typecheck-debt.json:3` (#6083), outside `src/**` and the census surface: a later stage of the card, as stages 1 to 4 recorded for their packages. Right to leave.
- The Docs Drift Check comment lists 8 hand-written pages that name `ObjectStackClient`: advisory; a comment-only diff falsifies none of them. Nothing escalated.
